object.attr: analysis: a condition on a deleted attribute matches differently, so a rule stops checking or a filter changes what it shows. The GUI names them before the change (MELLON-EDIT-SRS-105), an agent's dry run too (MELLON-EDIT-SRS-108).
object.description: When Mellon deletes an attribute that a filter or a rule condition names, Mellon shall report each such filter and rule with the result of the deletion.
